## Learning goals

Complete the exercises below using `fpp3`. Show plots and short written interpretations.

## Setup

```{r}
library(fpp3)
```


## 1. Simulate AR(1) and MA(1)

```{r}
set.seed(1)
ar1 <- tibble(
  idx = seq_len(300),
  y = as.numeric(arima.sim(model = list(ar = 0.7), n = 300))
) |>
  as_tsibble(index = idx)

ma1 <- tibble(
  idx = seq_len(300),
  y = as.numeric(arima.sim(model = list(ma = 0.7), n = 300))
) |>
  as_tsibble(index = idx)

ar1 |> ACF(y) |> autoplot()
ar1 |> PACF(y) |> autoplot()
ma1 |> ACF(y) |> autoplot()
ma1 |> PACF(y) |> autoplot()
```

## 2. Fit

```{r}
fit <- ar1 |> model(ARIMA(y ~ pdq(1, 0, 0) + PDQ(0, 0, 0)))
report(fit)
fit |> gg_tsresiduals()
```
